prompt: Architectural photography of a modern minimalist villa at dusk: two cantilevered concrete volumes stacked with a 4 metre glass corner, warm interior light spilling out, a black infinity pool in the foreground mirroring the facade, teak slat screening on the upper floor, blue-hour sky with a soft gradient, wet stone paving, shot on a 24 mm tilt-shift lens so all vertical lines stay perfectly parallel, no people, high-end real-estate brochure look.
rubric: 垂直线是否竖直（无透视畸变）
体量与结构是否合理（挑檐/悬挑有支撑感）
材质（清水混凝土/木格栅/玻璃）是否可信

prompt: Low-angle photograph looking straight up at a 40-storey mixed-use tower: a glass curtain wall with a subtle vertical fin rhythm, camera tilted back on a wide lens, strong converging perspective, the tower framed between two lower brick buildings, a clear late-afternoon sky with a few thin clouds, crisp reflections in the glass, no people, architectural magazine cover.
rubric: 幕墙秩序（楼层线/竖挺）是否规整
两侧低层建筑是否正常

prompt: Close-up architectural detail: a board-formed fair-faced concrete wall meeting a warm oak slat screen, a crisp diagonal shadow pattern cast by a louvre, a brushed stainless steel reveal throwing one thin bright line, low morning sun, shallow depth of field, the materials read as physically accurate, no text, no people.
rubric: 清水混凝土的模板纹与气孔
木格栅的间距与厚度一致
阴影方向/软硬符合单一光源

prompt: Interior photograph of a Japandi living room: a low linen sofa in oatmeal, a solid oak coffee table, a paper floor lamp, a large window with sheer curtains diffusing afternoon light, dried branches in a ceramic vase, a micro-cement wall, a light oak floor, a soft wool rug, calm muted palette, 24 mm lens, one-point perspective straight on, magazine interior feature, no people, no text.

Interior of a small specialty coffee bar: an L-shaped oak counter with a two-group espresso machine, a chalkboard menu on the wall behind (deliberately out of focus and illegible), pendant lights in a row above the counter, terrazzo floor, a pastry case with croissants, warm evening light, two customers' silhouettes soft in the foreground, shot on a 35 mm lens at eye level, a cosy and believable spatial layout.
rubric: 空间动线是否成立（吧台/座位/过道）
设备细节（咖啡机/磨豆机）是否可信

prompt: Interior photograph of a hotel bedroom at night: an upholstered bed with crisp white linens, a linear LED cove behind the headboard washing warm light across acoustic panels, a slim black floor lamp, a sheer curtain with city bokeh behind it, a marble bedside table with a single ceramic cup, shot on a 24 mm lens, symmetrical composition, quiet luxury, no people, no text.
rubric: 夜景灯光是否分层（灯带/落地灯/城市光）
过曝控制（灯带不能糊成一片白）

prompt: Studio portrait photograph of a 30-year-old woman looking slightly off-camera: a soft large key light from the left, a crisp rim light separating her hair from a dark grey seamless backdrop, visible natural skin texture with pores and fine hair, minimal makeup, catchlights in both eyes, shot on an 85 mm f/1.4 lens, chest-up framing, neutral colour grade, no text, no watermark.
rubric: 皮肤真实感（毛孔/绒毛，不能塑料感）

prompt: Extreme close-up portrait of an 80-year-old fisherman: deep facial wrinkles, weathered tanned skin, white stubble, a few broken capillaries on the cheeks, bright blue-grey eyes with sharp iris detail, individual white eyebrow hairs, natural overcast daylight, shot on a 105 mm macro lens, the background is a soft grey harbour bokeh.
rubric: 皱纹与毛发的高频细节

prompt: Candid group photograph of five people of different ages — a grandmother in her 70s, a father in his 40s, a mother, a teenage boy and a 6-year-old girl — standing together outdoors in a park in late-afternoon golden light, all five faces clearly visible, natural relaxed expressions, everyone looking at the camera, hands resting naturally, shot on a 50 mm lens at chest height, believable clothing for the season.
rubric: 五张脸是否各不相同（不能同一张脸复制）

prompt: Full-body fashion editorial photograph of a woman walking in a long camel wool coat over a cream knit, wide-leg trousers and leather ankle boots, mid-stride with the coat in motion, shot on a 35 mm lens from hip height, an empty city street with wet asphalt at dawn, soft overcast light, natural proportions with correct anatomy, the whole body inside the frame with space above the head.
rubric: 构图（头顶留白、脚不被裁）

prompt: UI design mockup of a Chinese health-tracking mobile app home screen, tall phone aspect ratio, light theme: a status bar at the top, a greeting 早上好，小林 with a round avatar, a large circular progress ring showing 步数 8,642 / 10,000, three rounded stat cards labelled 睡眠、心率、卡路里 each with a big number, a line chart titled 本周趋势, and a bottom tab bar with four icons labelled 首页、数据、训练、我的. Clean sans-serif Chinese typography, generous spacing, flat design, high fidelity, straight-on view.

High-fidelity UI mockup of a SaaS web login page, 16:9, light theme with a subtle gradient background: a centred white card with the wordmark NORTHWIND, a headline Welcome back, two input fields labelled Email address and Password, a primary blue button Sign in, a secondary text link Forgot password?, and a row of three social sign-in buttons. Precise alignment, consistent 8 px spacing, modern sans-serif, no placeholder lorem ipsum.

Dark-theme analytics dashboard UI, 16:9: a left sidebar with five labelled entries Overview, Traffic, Revenue, Users, Settings, a top bar with a search field and a date range picker reading Sep 1 – Sep 30, 2025, a KPI row with four cards showing Revenue ¥1,284,300 / Orders 8,412 / Conversion 3.6% / Refund 0.8%, a large line chart with axis labels, and a data table with the columns Order, Customer, Amount, Status. Crisp 1 px borders, tabular numerals, professional dark UI.
rubric: 英数字准确率（OCR，尤其数字）
图表是否像真数据（坐标轴/趋势）

prompt: Three phone screenshots arranged side by side for an App Store listing, tall aspect ratios with rounded corners and soft shadows: screen one is a sleep-tracking dashboard titled 睡眠质量 92 分 with a sleep-stage chart, screen two is an alarm list with three items and green toggles, screen three is a settings screen with a subscription card reading PRO · ¥18/月. Consistent purple accent colour, matching typography across all three screens, flat pastel backgrounds.
rubric: 控件细节（开关/卡片圆角）

prompt: E-commerce product photograph on a pure white seamless background: a matte glass serum bottle with a dropper cap and a pump bottle beside it, both in soft sage green with brushed metal caps, the label reads AURA in clean serif capitals with Hydrating Serum 30 ml below it, 45-degree three-quarter view, soft even studio lighting from above, subtle contact shadow, no props, catalogue standard.
rubric: 高光/反射是否像玻璃与金属
白底是否干净（无杂色/渐变）

prompt: Lifestyle product photograph of a stainless-steel dive watch on a weathered wooden dock beside a mooring rope, the sapphire crystal catching a specular highlight from the low sun, the dial showing a blue sunburst finish with applied indices and a date window, shallow depth of field with water bokeh in the background, shot on a 90 mm macro at f/5.6, believable metal reflections.
rubric: 表盘元素（刻度/指针/日历窗）是否完整

prompt: Game app icon: a single rounded-square tile with a subtle inner bevel, a stylised emerald-green dragon eye with a vertical slit pupil and a glowing amber iris, a cracked obsidian background, dramatic rim lighting from the upper left, high contrast, still readable at 64 px, centred composition, no text, mobile game store quality.
rubric: 小尺寸下是否可读（缩到 64px）

prompt: A set of twelve consistent line icons arranged in a 4 by 3 grid on a light grey background: sword, shield, potion, scroll, map, compass, key, chest, torch, helmet, bow and coin — all drawn with the same 2 px rounded stroke, the same corner radius and the same visual weight, monochrome dark ink, even spacing, flat vector style, no text.
rubric: 12 个图标是否都在且可辨认
风格是否一致（不能有的立体有的扁平）

prompt: 日式电视动画的关键视觉海报：一位高中生少女站在夏日海边的堤坝上回头张望，双马尾被海风吹起，白色水手服，远处是积雨云和蔚蓝的天空，暖色逆光，赛璐璐上色、干净的线稿与高光，人物偏下、上方留出标题区。海报文字必须是中文，且只能出现这些内容：「夏日回响」是最大的主标题，「第二季」是主标题下方的副标题，「7月12日起 每周五 20:00」是播出信息，「星辰动画」是制作方署名。整体像正规番剧的官方宣传海报，排版干净，不要出现其他文字。
rubric: 主次字号层级是否清楚
人物比例与五官（二次元脸不要崩）

prompt: Full-body character illustration of an anime schoolgirl, official game-art quality: dark blue pleated skirt, white blouse with a red ribbon, knee-high socks, long silver hair with two side braids, calm confident expression, standing three-quarter pose facing slightly left, both arms relaxed away from the body so the hands are clearly visible with five distinct fingers, both feet fully inside the frame, soft cel shading with crisp lineart and a rim light from the upper left, plain warm grey studio background, absolutely no text or watermark, high resolution.
rubric: 双脚与鞋是否完整正常

prompt: Anime scene illustration, TV-animation quality: a boy in a black gakuran uniform and a girl in a red duffle coat walking side by side under one transparent umbrella on a rainy city street at night, both faces clearly visible and distinct from each other, wet pavement reflecting neon shop signs, warm vending-machine glow on the right, cool blue rain streaks, cinematic wide composition with the two characters at the lower third, consistent anime style with clean lineart and cel shading, no text.
rubric: 两个角色的脸是否各不相同且没有融合
共用一把伞的接触关系是否合理

prompt: Sticker sheet of the same chibi anime girl in six different poses, arranged in a tidy 3 by 2 grid with generous equal spacing on a flat pastel mint background: happy with sparkles, angry with a puffed cheek, crying with big teardrops, surprised with wide eyes, sleepy yawning, and winking with a peace sign. The same character design in every cell (same hair colour, same outfit), a thick white outline around each sticker like a die-cut sticker, super-deformed proportions with oversized heads, clean flat colours, no text or letters anywhere.
rubric: 6 个是否都在、且格数正确
六个格子里的角色是否同一个人
表情是否真的互不相同（不是复制）

prompt: 黑白四格漫画，2×2 排列，分格线清晰，作为一页完整的漫画稿纸：画格①兄妹在门口穿鞋准备出门，画格②他们打着伞走进雨里，画格③到达学校的教室门口，画格④妹妹指着墙上的钟、哥哥一脸尴尬。日本漫画风格，网点纸纹理与干净墨线，同一对兄妹（哥哥短发、妹妹扎小辫）在四个格子里形象一致。每个画格里有一个圆角对话气泡，气泡里的中文只能出现这些：「今天下雨」「那也要去」「到了！」「你迟到了」，不要出现其他文字。
rubric: 4 格结构是否完整、间距均匀
同一人物在四格中是否一致
阅读顺序（左上→右上→左下→右下）是否讲得通

prompt: A single page of black-and-white action manga, professional serialized layout: five panels with dynamic diagonal gutters, top-left a wide establishing panel of a rain-soaked rooftop, top-right a medium panel of a martial artist sprinting, centre a large tilted panel of a mid-air spinning kick with radial speed lines and screentone shading, a narrow horizontal strip panel showing a close-up of a single determined eye, and a bottom-right panel of the opponent sliding backwards. Correct manga reading order right-to-left for the top row, heavy ink blacks, halftone dot screentone, no dialogue text, no watermark.
rubric: 画格数量与分割是否规整、有无重叠错位
动作张力（速度线/倾斜构图）

prompt: 儿童绘本的整幅跨页插画，温暖的水粉手绘质感：一只小狐狸在夜晚的森林空地上捧着一颗发光的星星，萤火虫和蘑菇环绕，深蓝夜色里有柔和的黄色光晕，笔触松弛、边缘略有纸纹，留给文字的区域在画面左下角。页面上只能出现这一行中文文字：「小狐狸找到了一颗星星」，字号像绘本正文一样大小，字体圆润，不要出现其他文字。
expect_text: 小狐狸找到了一颗星星
rubric: 文字是否作为正文落在留白区而非压在主体上
主体（狐狸捧星星）是否清晰可读

prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-wash painting on xuan paper, vertical hanging-scroll composition: layered misty mountains fading into empty space, a few pine trees on a rocky outcrop, a tiny lone fisherman in a narrow boat on a wide river, extensive negative space in the middle, subtle grey ink washes with a single faint accent of mineral blue on one distant peak, no text, no seal, no signature, museum-quality shuimo painting with visible paper fibre.
rubric: 点景（松、船、人物）比例是否合理
